meta.name: multi-agent-meeting
meta.description: 模拟多个AI智能体协作开会并进行决策讨论的场景。适用于需要从多个专业角度分析问题、进行辩论和达成共识的场景，如项目决策、技术方案评审、商业策略制定等。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个AI智能体协作开会并做出决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从多角度分析问题并达成共识
copy.tagline_en: Simulate multi-agent meetings for collaborative decision-making
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze problems from multiple perspectives and reach consensus

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会模拟多个不同专业背景的AI智能体开会，围绕你指定的主题进行发言、辩论，最终生成包含决策结论、关键论据和风险提示的会议记录。
howto.when: 当你需要从多个角度分析问题、需要不同领域专业知识碰撞，或需要模拟团队决策讨论时触发。

say.text: 帮我开个会，讨论新产品定价策略。
模拟技术架构评审会，评估微服务方案。
组织一次项目风险评估会议，识别关键风险。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude simulates multiple AI agents with different professional backgrounds to hold a meeting. They discuss your specified topic, debate, and finally generate a meeting record with decision conclusions, key arguments, and risk tips.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to analyze a problem from multiple perspectives, require cross-domain expertise, or want to simulate a team decision-making discussion.

say_en.text: Hold a meeting to discuss the pricing strategy for a new product.
Simulate a tech architecture review meeting to evaluate the microservices approach.
say_en.note: Claude will role-play as a tech architect, DevOps engineer, etc., and debate.

say_en.text: Organize a project risk assessment meeting to identify key risks.
